title: QuickNotes Online
engineRationale: Universal Node Engine explicitly requested. Scaffolding zero-dependency Node HTTP + Native SQLite WAL architecture.

architecture.frontend: Interactive contenteditable rich-text canvas with formatting toolbar, autosave status, and document browser sidebar in Vanilla HTML5/CSS3/ESM
architecture.backend: Zero-dependency Node HTTP REST server with document CRUD, autosave PATCH, and multi-format export (/api/documents/:id/export)
architecture.storage: Native Node.js SQLite (node:sqlite) with WAL mode and Document + Revision relational schema
architecture.exportPipeline: Server-side transforms to HTML, Markdown, Plain Text, and JSON

tasks.title: Relational SQLite Storage & Schemas
tasks.description: Set up persistent SQLite storage in app.db with table schemas for Record, Document.
acceptanceCriteria: Tables created with IF NOT EXISTS and proper column types
PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL enabled for high concurrency
Initial seed data injected when database is empty

tasks.title: REST API Operations & Handlers
tasks.description: Implement HTTP routes for queries and actions: getRecords, createRecord, deleteRecord.
acceptanceCriteria: GET endpoints return JSON arrays with 200 OK
POST/PATCH endpoints validate required fields and return 201/200
Health check at /api/health reports status: ok and storage: sqlite

tasks.title: Interactive UI & User Workflows
tasks.description: Build responsive client interface in public/ supporting observed workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: User can interact with all primary application workflows
State updates automatically after server actions
Clean visual styling with responsive design

tasks.title: Autosave & Document Recovery
tasks.description: Implement debounced background autosave with visual status indicator (Saving... / Saved).
acceptanceCriteria: Autosave triggers after typing pause (500ms)
Status indicator displays current persistence state
Document content persists across browser refresh and server restarts

tasks.title: Multi-Format Document Export Pipeline
tasks.description: Implement document export endpoint for HTML, Markdown, Plain Text, and JSON.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/documents/:id/export?format=html returns standalone HTML document
GET /api/documents/:id/export?format=markdown returns markdown syntax
GET /api/documents/:id/export?format=text returns plain text content
GET /api/documents/:id/export?format=json returns structured document JSON

tasks.title: Automated Verification & Self-Testing
tasks.description: Generate test.js and workflow.test.js to verify all acceptance criteria and workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: test.js verifies database creation, table schemas, and data persistence
workflow.test.js executes each workflow sequence end-to-end against live endpoints
